units.rawText: Huh, so that's how far apart the two of them are? What about busting it up with pure force?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, Professor, we cannot. I went out of my way to test a hypothesis I had, which is that I am currently the only one who can use long-range messaging capabilities in the Oasis.

units.rawText: This won't work and that won't work too. Man, what a headache... Ah, that's right, don't we have Anna?

spans.text: This won't work and that won't work too. Man, what a headache... Ah, that's right, don't we have Anna?

units.displayText: No, I didn't crack the firewall.

units.rawText: It's simply because I'm very familiar with Antonina's handiwork, and I know her habits and patterns when it comes to leaving backdoors, so I decided to see if I could take advantage of it.

units.rawText: Honestly, I wouldn't have thought of that at all if you hadn't reminded me. You were a great help, Sol.

units.rawText: Yes, yes, you're the best, Sol~ Hurry up and head in, the Oasis is still waiting for us to bring back the operands.

units.rawText: After passing through the firewall and leaving the passage, we see an extremely futuristic-looking city spreading out before our eyes. The broad, crisscrossing streets, the densely-packed rows of skyscrapers, the agents walking here and there... All of it stands as a stark contrast to the open land on the sector outskirts.

units.rawText: This place is huge... Is this the Rossum Sector? If I didn't know that, I might have thought that I'd returned to a city in the real world.

units.rawText: I didn't dare to ask. I had the feeling she was more intelligent than the other agents.

units.rawText: The other agents might have just gone "Insufficient Access" if they sensed something wrong, but she looked like the kind who would sound the alarm immediately.

11.name: Body
11.description: Bodies operated by Dolls in the physical world.

30.name: Signature
30.description: An authentication code that contains an Agent's basic information, essentially an Agent's "identity card" within Magrasea. When flagging anomalous programs, Sanctifiers rely heavily on the Agents' signatures.

40.name: Firewall
40.description: A protective barrier that stops foreign programs from invading. Most sectors are protected by firewalls. Agents are also equipped with micro-firewalls that repel viral attacks from other programs.

42.name: Data Port
42.description: A special port for transferring and accessing data found on all Agents.

50.name: Command
50.description: Agents must obey and act according to commands written in their codes. There are two kinds of commands—base commands and regular commands. The former is written at the time of an Agent's creation and dictate their behavior, while the latter are issued after the Agent becomes active and assign them tasks.
